name: google-login
description: Adds Google sign-in for Tovu members using this site's own Google OAuth client. Includes setup guidance for apps using Supabase Auth.
author: Tovu

tovu.summary: Let members sign in with Google, or set up Google in an app's existing Supabase Auth.

credentialCards.title: Set up Google member login
credentialCards.label: google-login/google OAuth client
credentialCards.intro: Use this site's own Google Web application client to let members sign in with Google. Enter the Client ID below and the Client Secret in the secure secret field.
usedFor: Lets members sign in to this site with Google
credentialCards.keyHint: In Google Auth Platform → Clients, create a Web application. Add this site's configured address plus /api/members/v1/workspaces/<workspaceId>/oidc/google/callback as an authorized redirect URI; ask the assistant for the exact address. Paste the Client Secret here, never in chat. For Supabase Auth only, enter it directly in Supabase instead.

fields.name: username
fields.label: Google client ID
fields.hint: Required. Use the client ID belonging to the same Web application as the Client Secret.
